u1.english: Hi! My name is Mia. What's your name?
u1.chinese: 嗨！我叫米娅。你叫什么名字？

u1.english: I'm Leo. Nice to meet you, Mia!
u1.chinese: 我是里奥。很高兴认识你，米娅！

u1.english: Nice to meet you too, Leo!
u1.chinese: 我也很高兴认识你，里奥！

u2.english: It's nine o'clock. Our class starts now!

u2.chinese: 太好了！今天是星期一，对吧？

u3.english: Is that your sister in the photo?
Yes! She is a doctor, and she's very kind.
u3.chinese: 是的！她是一名医生，而且她很亲切。

u4.english: I'm hungry. What would you like to eat?
I'd like an apple and some juice, please.
u4.chinese: 我想要一个苹果和一些果汁。

u4.english: Sounds good! I'll have a sandwich.
u4.chinese: 听起来不错！我要一个三明治。

u5.english: Have you seen my blue notebook?
u5.chinese: 你看到我的蓝色笔记本了吗？

u5.english: Yes, it's next to the red pencil.
u5.chinese: 看到了，它在红色铅笔旁边。

u6.english: What do you do after school?
I usually read, but today I'm playing basketball.
u6.chinese: 我通常看书，但今天我要打篮球。

u7.english: It's sunny today. Shall we go outside?
u7.chinese: 今天天气晴朗。我们出去走走好吗？

u7.english: Sure! Spring is my favorite season.
u7.chinese: 好呀！春天是我最喜欢的季节。
我们去享受温暖的天气吧！

u8.english: How do we get to the train station?
Take the bus, then turn left at the bank.
u8.chinese: 坐公交车，然后在银行处左转。

u9.english: How much is this green bag?
It's twenty dollars. Do you like it?

u10.english: You don't look well. What's wrong?
u10.chinese: 你看起来不太舒服。怎么了？

u10.english: I have a headache. I need some rest.
u10.chinese: 我头疼。我需要休息一下。

u10.english: Drink some water and feel better soon!

u11.english: English! We have a test on Friday.

u11.chinese: 放学后我们一起学习吧。

u12.english: Do you want to see a movie tonight?
I'd love to! I also enjoy music.
We can listen to songs on the way.

u13.english: Would you like to come to my party?
u13.chinese: 你想来参加我的聚会吗？

u13.english: Thanks for inviting me! When is it?

u14.english: What should we visit on our trip?
u14.chinese: 旅行时我们该参观哪里？

u14.english: Let's see the museum and try local food.
u14.chinese: 去看看博物馆，再尝尝当地美食吧。

u14.english: That sounds like a wonderful day!
u14.chinese: 听起来会是很棒的一天！

u15.english: Excuse me, how can I get to the bank?
u15.chinese: 打扰一下，去银行怎么走？

u15.english: Go straight and turn right at the store.
u15.chinese: 直走，然后在商店处右转。

u15.english: Thank you! I'll buy some coffee on the way.
u15.chinese: 谢谢！我路上再买点咖啡。

u16.english: Do you want to go hiking this weekend?
Yes! But I have a headache today.
u16.chinese: 想去！不过我今天有点头疼。

u16.english: Rest well first. Sports can wait!
u16.chinese: 先好好休息。运动可以等一等！

u17.english: What are you going to do this weekend?
u17.chinese: 这个周末你打算做什么？

u17.english: Let's meet at three and study together.
u17.chinese: 我们三点见面，一起学习吧。

u17.english: Great! I want to improve my speaking too.
u17.chinese: 太好了！我也想提高口语。

u18.english: Which bag do you like better?
This one is better, and it is my favorite color.
u18.chinese: 这个更好，而且是我最喜欢的颜色。

u18.english: I agree. This is bigger than that one.

u19.english: I went to the park. It was an unforgettable day.
u19.chinese: 我去了公园。那是难忘的一天。

u19.english: Nice! I went to Beijing last year.

u20.english: I feel tired today. What should I do?
u20.chinese: 我今天很累。我该怎么办？

u20.english: You should drink more water and rest.
u20.chinese: 你应该多喝水，休息一下。

u20.english: Thanks. Could you help me with my homework later?
u20.chinese: 谢谢。之后你能帮我做作业吗？

u21.english: Who is that girl with long hair?
u21.chinese: 那个留长发的女孩是谁？

u21.english: She is my best friend. She is friendly and likes football.
u21.chinese: 她是我最好的朋友。她很友好，还喜欢足球。

u22.english: The mountains are high. Shall we go hiking?
u22.chinese: 山很高。我们去爬山好吗？

u22.english: Yes, but please save water on the way.
u22.chinese: 好，不过路上请节约用水。

u22.english: Of course. Parks need trees too.

u23.english: Oh no, my phone is out of battery.
Use my charger. Smart watches are cool, but phones come first.
u23.chinese: 用我的充电器吧。智能手表很酷，但手机更重要。

u23.english: Thanks! And please mute in the meeting later.
u23.chinese: 谢谢！等会儿开会请静音。

u24.english: I am busy today. Can we cooperate on this task?
u24.chinese: 我今天很忙。这个任务我们能合作吗？

u24.english: Sure. Sorry to interrupt—please introduce yourself first.
u24.chinese: 当然。抱歉打断——请先介绍一下自己。

u25.english: I run three times a week now.
Good! Eat more vegetables and sleep well.
u25.chinese: 很好！多吃蔬菜，好好睡觉。

u25.english: I will. I was under some pressure last month.
u25.chinese: 我会的。上个月我压力有点大。

u26.english: Happy Mid-Autumn Festival to your family too!
When in Rome, do as the Romans do.

u27.english: This movie is touching. Want to watch it again?
u27.chinese: 这部电影很感人。想再看一遍吗？

u27.english: Maybe later. This song is beautiful too.
u27.chinese: 晚点吧。这首歌也很好听。

u27.english: True. And this book is worth reading.
u27.chinese: 没错。而且这本书值得读。

u28.english: The neighbors are friendly. I want to be a volunteer.
u28.chinese: 邻居很友善。我想做志愿者。

u28.english: Great! The library is free, and we can help there.
u28.chinese: 太好了！图书馆免费开放，我们可以去帮忙。

u28.english: If there is danger, please call emergency services.
u28.chinese: 如果有危险，请拨打急救电话。

u29.english: I keep accounts now. I want to save for a trip.
u29.chinese: 我现在记账了。我想存钱去旅行。

u29.english: Smart. I use mobile payment and compare before I buy.
u29.chinese: 聪明。我用移动支付，买之前先比较。

u29.english: Same here. Let's be careful with money.
u29.chinese: 我也是。我们花钱要小心。

u30.english: I want to book a ticket and a hotel room.
u30.chinese: 我想订票，再订一间酒店房。

u30.english: I booked a room already. Don't get lost!
u30.chinese: 我已经订好房间了。别迷路！

u30.english: Thanks. I hope the view exceeds expectations.
u30.chinese: 谢谢。希望景色超出预期。

u31.english: What do you think about online learning?
I agree with you. It is more convenient.
u31.chinese: 我同意你的看法。它更方便。

u31.english: My view is to keep learning every day.
u31.chinese: 我的观点是每天坚持学习。

u32.english: I have an exam next week. I'm a bit nervous.
u32.chinese: 我下周有考试。有点紧张。

u32.english: You have improved a lot. Just keep practicing.
u32.chinese: 你已经进步很多了。继续练习就好。

u32.english: Thanks! Let's celebrate after the test.
u32.chinese: 谢谢！考完我们庆祝一下。

u33.english: I am sorry I am late. That was my fault.
u33.chinese: 对不起，我迟到了。这是我的错。

u33.english: It's okay. Can you help me fix this problem?
u33.chinese: 没关系。你能帮我解决这个问题吗？

u33.english: Sure. Let's deal with it and start over.
u33.chinese: 当然。我们处理好，然后重新开始。

u34.english: My dream is to travel around the world.
You can do it. Do not give up!
I will practice every day. The future is in our hands.
u34.chinese: 我会每天练习。未来掌握在我们手中。

z_u1.english: This is A. Can you say B?
z_u1.chinese: 这是 A。你能说 B 吗？

z_u2.english: How many apples do you see?

z_u3.english: It is red. I like blue too.
Red and blue are nice colors.

z_u4.english: Please sit down and open your book.
Okay. May I ask a question?
z_u4.chinese: 好的。我可以问个问题吗？

z_u5.english: This is my hand, and these are my feet.
z_u5.chinese: 这是我的手，这些是我的脚。

z_u6.english: This is my mom. Who is that?
That is my dad. I love my family.
z_u6.chinese: 那是我爸爸。我爱我的家人。
你的家人看起来很幸福。

z_u7.english: I am hungry. Can I have some bread?
z_u7.chinese: 我饿了。我可以吃点面包吗？

z_u7.english: Sure. Would you like some water too?

z_u8.english: Look! A cat and a dog.
I like birds. Do you like fish?

z_u9.english: It is cold today. Wear a coat.

z_u10.english: It is seven. Time for breakfast.
I go to bed at nine.

z_u11.english: It is next to the library.

z_u12.english: The park is on the left.
Is the shop on the right?

z_u13.english: I feel happy. Are you sad?

z_u14.english: How do you go to school?
I go by bus. Sometimes I walk.
z_u14.chinese: 我坐公交车。有时我走路。

z_u15.english: It is five yuan. Please take it.

z_u16.english: Let's review. What color is the book?
z_u16.chinese: 我们复习一下。这本书是什么颜色？

z_u16.english: It is green. I can count to ten.

z_u17.english: Good morning! This is my friend Ben.
z_u17.chinese: 早上好！这是我的朋友本。

z_u18.english: My name is Leo. I am ten years old.
I am Mia. Nice to meet you.
z_u18.chinese: 我是米娅。很高兴认识你。

z_u19.english: I have many books on my desk.
How many bags do you have?

z_u20.english: This box is big. That one is small.
z_u20.chinese: 这个盒子很大。那个很小。

z_u21.english: It is next to the living room.

z_u22.english: I will clean my desk now.

z_u23.english: Today is Monday. School starts at eight.

z_u24.english: I get up early every day.
I brush my teeth after breakfast.

z_u25.english: Do you like apples or bananas?
I like apples. What about you?

z_u28.english: It is raining. Take an umbrella.
Summer is hot. Winter is cold.

z_u29.english: The park is near my home.
Let's go to the library later.

z_u30.english: Ten yuan. Do you want the blue bag too?
z_u30.chinese: 十元。你也想要蓝色的包吗？

z_u30.english: Yes. I will take it. Thank you!

z_u31.english: You should see a doctor if you feel worse.
z_u31.chinese: 如果更难受，你应该去看医生。

z_u31.english: I will rest and drink water.

z_u32.english: I will read one page today.

z_u33.english: Happy birthday! This gift is for you.
z_u33.chinese: 生日快乐！这是给你的礼物。

z_u33.english: Thank you! Let us cut the cake.

z_u34.english: Be careful when you cross the road.
I will. Please help me if I get lost.
z_u34.chinese: 我会的。如果我迷路了请帮帮我。

u35.english: What time does the meeting start?
At three. Could you take a look at this report?
u35.chinese: 三点。你能看一下这份报告吗？

u35.english: Sure. I will send you my feedback today.
u35.chinese: 当然。我今天会把反馈发给你。

u36.english: Are you free on Wednesday afternoon?
Yes. Please send me an email with the details.
u36.chinese: 有。请把细节发邮件给我。

u36.english: Done. Looking forward to your reply.

u37.english: Do you have a table for two?
Yes. Are you ready to order?
u37.chinese: 有。你们准备好点餐了吗？

u37.english: Not too spicy, please. And bring the bill later.
u37.chinese: 请不要太辣。稍后请把账单拿来。

u38.english: Is this apartment still for rent?
Yes. The rent is eight thousand a month.
Great. When can I move in?
u38.chinese: 太好了。什么时候可以入住？

u39.english: Please help me connect to Wi-Fi.
Sure. Do not share your password with strangers.
u39.chinese: 好。不要把密码告诉陌生人。

u39.english: Got it. I will turn on two-factor authentication.
u39.chinese: 明白。我会开启两步验证。

u40.english: Shall we go to the gym today?
Yes. Warming up is important first.
Agreed. Do not push yourself too hard.

u41.english: Okay. Should I take off my shoes here?

u42.english: Someone is hurt. Please call an ambulance.
u42.chinese: 有人受伤了。请叫救护车。

u42.english: I will. Stay calm and tell me your location.
u42.chinese: 我会的。保持冷静，告诉我你的位置。

u42.english: We are near the park gate.

u43.english: Please sort the trash before you leave.
Sure. Plastic bottles can be recycled.
And turn off the lights. Save energy.

u44.english: Are you free this weekend? Let us study English together.
u44.chinese: 这个周末你有空吗？我们一起学英语吧。

u44.english: Sounds good. Could you explain a bit more slowly?
u44.chinese: 听起来不错。你能解释得慢一点吗？

u44.english: Of course. Now you understand — great!
u44.chinese: 当然。现在你明白了——太好了！

z_u35.chinese: 是的，我们在这里种玉米。

z_u35.english: Can I help feed the hens?

z_u37.english: Where shall we have our picnic?
Let us sit under that tree.
Great, I will spread the blanket.

z_u39.english: I like the one with flowers.

z_u40.english: Yes, I have my swimming cap.

z_u41.english: Yes, our seats are by the window.
z_u41.chinese: 是的，我们的座位在窗边。

z_u42.english: My friend helped me find my hat.
z_u42.chinese: 我的朋友帮我找到了帽子。

z_u42.english: That was kind of your friend.

u45.english: Could I check in for my flight?
u45.chinese: 我可以办理航班登机手续吗？

u45.english: Certainly. May I see your passport?
u45.chinese: 当然，请出示您的护照好吗？

u45.english: Here it is. I have one bag to check.
u45.chinese: 在这里，我有一个包要托运。

u46.english: I think I have lost my bank card.
We can block it and arrange a replacement.
u46.chinese: 我们可以冻结它并安排补卡。

u46.english: Thank you. What information do you need?

u47.english: My washing machine will not start.
I can send a technician on Friday afternoon.
u47.chinese: 我可以安排维修人员星期五下午上门。

u47.english: That works for me. Please call before arriving.
u47.chinese: 我方便，请到达前打电话。

u48.english: Would you like to volunteer on Saturday?
u48.chinese: 你想星期六做志愿者吗？

u48.english: Yes. What kind of help do you need?
We need someone to welcome the visitors.
u48.chinese: 我们需要人接待来访者。

u49.english: This message says the event starts at ten.
u49.chinese: 这条消息说活动十点开始。

u49.english: The official website says eleven. Let us check.
u49.chinese: 官方网站说十一点，我们核实一下吧。

u49.english: Good idea. I will contact the organizer.
u49.chinese: 好主意，我会联系组织者。

u50.english: We spent more than our budget this week.
u50.chinese: 我们这周花得超过预算了。

u50.english: Let us check the bills and plan next week.
u50.chinese: 我们检查账单并计划下周吧。

u50.english: I can cut back on snacks to save money.
u50.chinese: 我可以减少买零食来省钱。

u51.english: What skill would you like to improve?
I want to understand spoken English better.
u51.chinese: 我想更好地理解英语口语。

u51.english: Let us practice listening for fifteen minutes daily.
u51.chinese: 我们每天练十五分钟听力吧。

u52.english: What was the best part of your trip?
u52.chinese: 你旅行中最棒的部分是什么？

u52.english: Meeting local people and trying their food.
u52.chinese: 认识当地人并品尝他们的食物。

u52.english: That sounds wonderful. I hope to go there too.
u52.chinese: 听起来很棒，我也希望去那里。
